text: CoreWeave reports $2.58B in quarterly revenue, $104B in backlog, 1.5 GW of active power, and $35B in debt. It targets more than 1.85 GW of active power by year-end and $35B-$39B in 2026 capital expenditures. Net loss stands at $626M.

meta.note: Backlog excludes more than $25B in third-quarter commitments.
